title: About this program

title: Business analysis and specification writing
summary: Requirements, specifications, research, comparisons, memos, decision records, and traceability. The first complete case, because everyone does some of it.

title: Customer support
summary: Intake, triage, response, escalation, and follow-up, and, when it is ready, workflows assisted by the organization's integrated support system.

title: Cases
summary: Three entrances, one working model. Find the case that looks like your week.

summary: Repository analysis, design, coding, review, documentation, and coordination with a development team, including work directed by a person who does not write code.

title: Environments
summary: Where the assistant will work. Setup branches by the approved place, not by whether you are technical. Not sure is a complete answer.

title: Turn a vague request into a clear problem statement
summary: From a forwarded email and a few attachments to a one-page statement of what is happening, who it affects, what is known, and what is not.

title: Extract requirements in the authors' own words
summary: Lift every candidate requirement out of the sources, each with the exact sentence it came from, so nothing is invented and nothing is lost.

title: Sort a document's claims into the four labels
summary: Take any document, draft, or thread and label every claim as Verified, Inferred, Decided, or Open, so the reader knows exactly what stands on what.

title: Compare options against criteria you set first
summary: Set the criteria before looking at the options, then let the assistant build a sourced comparison, so the recommendation follows from the criteria and not the other way round.

title: Draft a specification you can trace to its sources
summary: Turn a traced requirements list and the decisions made about it into a specification where every statement can be followed back to its origin.

title: Check a memo before it goes out
summary: Before a memo goes to people who will act on it, have the assistant read it the way a skeptical reader will, and fix what it finds.

title: Task guides
summary: Step-by-step guides for real tasks. Do the work, then govern it. This is the part of the portal you will come back to.

title: Home
